title: 2027 Automation & Process Analytics Technology Co-Op (June - Dec)
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Envision working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie’s Co-Ops.  This is a work experience and is not intended to support a thesis.
Product Development Science and Technology (PDS&T): Designs, delivers, and supports biologics manufacturing processes for AbbVie’s pipeline and partnered products through clinical development and commercial life cycle. The department advances targeted product quality, CMC acceleration, people development, and efficient workflows, bringing together expertise across Cell Line Development, Cell Culture Process Development, Purification Process Development, Scale-Up Lab, and Analytical Development.
We are seeking an exceptional graduate co-op student to join our Cell Culture Development and Automation team for an innovative, hands-on project at the intersection of optical spectroscopy, cell culture science, laboratory robotics, and data analytics. In this role, you will help integrate spectroscopy with automated liquid-handling robotics to enable rapid, at-line characterization of cell-culture product quality and metabolites. You will have the opportunity to build novel hardware, develop automated analytical workflows, and apply chemometric and data-science modeling to production-relevant datasets, helping transform how process development teams learn from experiments.
Key responsibilities include:
Supporting integration of spectroscopy systems with an automated liquid-handling platform for high-throughput, at-line spectral acquisition from cell culture samples.
Designing and 3D printing custom labware and sampling components to support automated sample transfer and spectral measurement.
Developing and troubleshoot automated liquid-handler methods for sample acquisition, flow-cell delivery, and system wash and cleaning cycles.
Performing aseptic cell culture techniques, including thawing, passaging, and banking of mammalian (CHO) cell lines, to support experimental studies.
Collecting, processing, and analyzing Raman spectral and process data; apply chemometric and data-science techniques to build predictive models for metabolites and product quality attributes.
Collaborating cross-functionally with scientists in cell culture development, automation engineering, and analytical development to refine workflows using experimental results and team feedback.
Documenting experimental methods, data, and results clearly; contribute to a final presentation and/or manuscript-quality summary suitable for internal or external scientific communication.
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Chemistry or a related field.
Must be enrolled in university at the time of the Co-Op.
Expected graduation date between May 2028 – Dec 2028
Proficient in aseptic techniques, including thawing, passaging, and banking mammalian cell lines in a biosafety cabinet.
Knowledge of optical spectroscopy techniques, including Raman, fluorescence, and absorbance.
Knowledge of biology and biochemistry, cell metabolism, and protein characterization as applied to CHO cell culture development.
Must be able to commit to a 6-month program at AbbVie’s site located in Worcester, MA (June - December).
Preferred Qualifications
Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex laboratory robotics and instrumentation challenges.
Ability to design and create custom labware using 3D printing.
Ability to execute, troubleshoot, and interpret complex experimental data to determine thoughtful next steps.
Working knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python, Visual Basic and C/C++.

Drug Substance Engineering Internship Overview
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.
Micronization of drug substance is a critical process in API manufacturing for ensuring downstream critical quality attributes. Micronization processes such as pin milling and jet milling leverage feed rate control to optimize the process performance, and while feed rate is well understood for many powder systems there is a gap in understanding the feed rate control of poorly flowing materials in micronization techniques.
The Drug Substance Engineering Intern within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) will help establish a systematic approach to understand how the physical properties of powder systems impact their feeding performance in micronization processes.
Key responsibilities include:
Experimental studies to understand and characterize powder properties
Evaluate performance of micronization techniques (i.e. jet mill, pin mill) with various feed mechanisms
Analyze data and trends to identify signatures for process performance
Develop and verify computational models
Summarize and present findings in departmental and cross-functional settings
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a PhD in Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or other related field
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the internship

Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to comminution processes
Experience with physical characterization techniques (flowability, adhesion, cohesion, bulk density, laser diffraction particle size determination)

The intern will work alongside experienced formulation scientists and analytical chemists to characterize this phenomenon and help define strategies to ensure robust, high-quality drug product formulations. Investigate the mechanism of excipient degradation in the presence of pH modifiers using appropriate analytical techniques (e.g., HPLC, titration and colorimetrical methods).
Collaborate on LC/MS analysis to identify and characterize leachable degradants associated with the implications to stabilizing the drug substance in the formulation.

​Guide implementation and technical decisions. Evaluate build, reuse, and purchase options; recommend solutions based on business value, technical fit, risk, and total cost of ownership. Contribute to prototypes or code where needed to validate architecture and resolve key technical challenges.

Define production-readiness expectations, including testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, documentation, and ongoing cost and performance optimization. Incorporate user feedback and operational lessons into solution improvements.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Associate Director, Field Tools & Analytics owns the overall strategy, technology roadmap, and solution architecture for Oncology field tools that enable the sales organization to operate effectively across solid and liquid tumor brands. This role sets the long-range vision for field tools, determines platform and technology investments, and ensures tools scale with evolving brand and franchise needs. The Associate Director leads a team of two direct reports (Senior Manager and Manager, Field Tools & Analytics) who execute day-to-day operations against this strategy.
Responsibilities
Strategic Planning & Technology Roadmap
Own and author the long-range strategic plan and multi-year technology roadmap for all Oncology field tools.
Set priorities for platform investment, retirement, and consolidation decisions based on franchise needs and ROI.
Anticipate future field force needs and proactively evolve the toolset ahead of business demand.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Architect end-to-end field tool solutions, defining system design, data flows, and integration points across CRM, analytics, and reporting platforms.
Set technical and business requirement standards; final approver on major system design decisions.
Partner with IT, BTS, and OEC to ensure architecture aligns with enterprise technology standards and compliance requirements.
Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the executive-level point of contact and escalation path across Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, IT, Training, OEC, Legal, and Medical/Regulatory.
Provide final sign-off on business requirements, enhancement prioritization, and project scope for major initiatives.
Lead cross-functional governance forums to align technology decisions with brand and franchise strategy.
Team Leadership & People Management
Directly manage and develop the Senior Manager and Manager, Field Tools & Analytics.
Ensure the team is resourced appropriately for current and future demand; delegate operational execution to direct reports.
Coach, mentor, and set clear goals/expectations; conduct performance management and career development.
Executive Stakeholder Relationship Management
Build and maintain trusted relationships with VPs, Sales Directors, and Analytics leadership.
Act as a credible, strategic advisor capable of influencing senior executives on technology direction and investment decisions without direct authority.
BA/BS degree required; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of pharmaceutical or relevant industry experience, including experience setting technology strategy or architecting commercial solutions.
Demonstrated people leadership experience managing managers or senior individual contributors.
Strong executive presence; able to confidently advise Executive and Sales Leadership on strategic technology decisions.
Preferred Technical Skills
Salesforce/Veeva CRM: strategic and architectural understanding of platform capability.
Data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, QlikView) — ability to evaluate and select tools at an enterprise level.
SQL or equivalent database management — able to assess data architecture decisions.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Lead Publications Teams in the execution of publication plans for assigned assets, and oversee the execution
of scientific publications (ie, clinical manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations) that fulfill
strategic publication plan and scientific communications objectives for the asset. Ensure Publication Plan is in alignment with the strategic publication plan as developed by the Scientific Communication Platform lead or Medical Affairs plans as applicable. In partnership with the Publications Director ensure resources and
personnel are aligned and optimized to meet with needs of their therapeutic area. Provide managerial
oversight to staff members, including performance assessment, training and feedback, resolution of personnel issues, and management of talent retention.
Responsibilities :
Serve as the leader of cross-functional Publications Team(s) for assigned assets, including leading team meetings/discussions and driving the execution of publication plans, incorporating input from key global stakeholders
Lead tactical execution of publication plans (ie, clinical manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations), meeting established timelines and budgets
Review all publications in assigned TA to ensure quality and alignment with Scientific Communication Platforms and supporting communications
Partner with the Scientific Communications Director to ensure seamless transfer of the scientific publications strategic plan and oversee pull-through to publication plan and supporting tactics
Partner with Publications Director to project and manage outsourcing budget and internal resource needs for assigned/assets
Provide managerial oversight to internal and external medical writers regarding assigned projects, ensuring a high-quality and timely work product and adherence to Publication Policy and associated Procedures
Provide direction to external vendors to effectively complete the execution of publication projects, within specified timelines, and ensure quality publication deliverables
Ensure all performance assessment responsibilities are achieved for direct reports. Provide training and feedback, resolve personnel issues, and manage talent retention for assigned staff
Address and resolve publications-related issues for assigned therapeutic areas and assets. Ensure project information in publication records and resourcing tools is accurate and up-to-date
Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree required. PhD, PharmD, Master’s Degree preferred. Relevant professional certification/credential (eg, CMPP, AMWA) is a plus.
4-5 years of medical/scientific publications (or related) experience required. Pharmaceutical industry or related (eg, medical communication agency) experience required
Demonstrated abilities in a leadership capacity required
Ability to understand and interpret medical data require
Knowledge of product therapeutic area preferred; working knowledge of statistical concepts and techniques required
Knowledge of clinical/scientific publication structure, content, and quality. Knowledge of scientific publication regulations and best practices
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with demonstrated success in creating and delivering effective presentations to senior-level audiences
Builds strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of the team to enable higher performance. Collaborative teamwork and leadership track record
Ability to form, maintain, and lead productive cross-functional working teams, including addressing issues that arise
Microsoft Office and Internet navigation proficiencies essential
Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​
The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

description:

The Analytics and Performance Excellence (APEX) team is an industry-recognized center of research excellence and strategic vision. We function as in-house strategic counsel — translating advanced analytics into business decisions and patient impact. We invest in diverse talent, cultivate new capabilities, and foster an inclusive culture where the best ideas win.
Role Summary
As Senior Manager within the Market Access & Patient Services Insights group, you will independently lead analytics and market research initiatives that shape U.S. Immunology brand strategy. You will identify payer opportunities, assess risk scenarios, and deliver actionable recommendations that advance patient access and provider reimbursement — with a particular emphasis on the medical benefit landscape, buy-and-bill dynamics, and ASP-driven pricing strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Analytics & Data Science
Lead advanced analytics across utilization management, medical policy, pricing, and competitive launch assessment.
Apply modeling, data science, and visualization tools to surface actionable business insights.
Develop contracting strategies grounded in quantitative analysis of specialty pharmacies, PBMs, GPOs, health plans, and medical benefit access dynamics.
Analyze reimbursement and access trends spanning buy-and-bill, ASP, site of care, and provider-administered therapies.
Mine healthcare and operational datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improved access and execution.
Market Research
Design and execute market research initiatives assessing payer dynamics, access barriers, and competitive positioning.
Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into clear, strategy-ready insights.
Track competitive launches and evolving healthcare policy through rigorous research methodologies.
Inform medical benefit access, provider-administered therapy, and reimbursement strategy through targeted insights development.

The individual will turn qualitative and quantitative primary and secondary research and analytics into clear, actionable learnings, and partner with Brand, Medical, and external agency partners to inform business decisions. Assist in synthesizing findings across research and analytics into clear insights and recommendations.

Provide foundational analytics on market dynamics, patients, and accounts to support launch planning.

Apply appropriate analytic approaches, partnering with analytics colleagues and suppliers on more advanced models. Communicate results clearly so brand partners can act on them to improve performance.
Contribute analyses and content to regular business reviews.
Explore and apply AI and generative AI tools to speed up and improve research and analytics, from synthesis and reporting to uncovering insights in data, while using sound judgment on accuracy, data privacy, and compliance.
Present learnings with thoughtful confidence to brand teams, cross-functional partners, and leadership as needed.
Build solid relationships as a team player while staying objective and unbiased in representing the voice of the customer.
Manage and collaborate with onshore and offshore research and analytics suppliers.

Our team is responsible for the development, qualification, and execution of analytical methods to provide product and process understanding for biological entities from discovery through commercial stages. As a Senior Scientist I, you will be a part of the Analytical Characterization Group (ACG) within the Analytical Development department. Lead Publications Teams in the execution of publication plans for assigned assets, and oversee the execution

strategic publication plan and scientific communications objectives for the asset. Ensure Publication Plan is in
alignment with the strategic publication plan as developed by the Scientific Communication Platform lead or
Medical Affairs plans as applicable. In partnership with the Publications Director ensure resources and
personnel are aligned and optimized to meet with needs of their therapeutic area. Provide managerial
oversight to staff members, including performance assessment, training and feedback, resolution of personnel
issues, and management of talent retention.

This role will report to the Director of Pub Execution to lead a team of publication managers.  This role will lead, support, and develop a team by setting clear expectations, communicating priorities, and providing regular coaching and feedback. Foster an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative environment, and follow applicable company policies and people practices.

Lead tactical execution of publication plans (ie, clinical manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations), meeting established timelines and budgets
Review all publications in assigned TA to ensure quality and alignment with Scientific Communication Platforms and supporting communications

Provide direction to external vendors to effectively complete the execution of publication projects, within specified timelines, and ensure quality publication deliverables

Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree required. PhD, PharmD, Master’s Degree preferred. Relevant professional certification/credential (eg, CMPP, AMWA) is a plus.

Demonstrated abilities in a leadership capacity required
Ability to understand and interpret medical data require
Knowledge of product therapeutic area preferred; working knowledge of statistical concepts and techniques required
Knowledge of clinical/scientific publication structure, content, and quality. Knowledge of scientific publication regulations and best practices
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with demonstrated success in creating and delivering effective presentations to senior-level audiences
Builds strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of the team to enable higher performance. Collaborative teamwork and leadership track record

title: Strategic Account Manager - Louisiana and Mississippi
description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
This role is field-based throughout Louisiana and Mississippi, with the expectation of being out in the field 5 days a week
The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) is responsible for representing the SkinMedica, DiamondGlow and Latisse brands and promote the product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. This is accomplished by utilizing and managing key resources and contributing with high performance selling teams to maximize coverage to targeted customers. The SAM provides technical product and procedure expertise, as well as, competitive product differentiation. Assigned sales goals are obtained through creative, consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.
Responsibilities
The SAM leverages Allergan Medical’s resources to enhance adoption of the SKM Portfolio which includes 1) non-surgical, non-invasive skin resurfacing equipment, 2) topical skincare consumables designed for the resurfacing device and 3) SkinMedica product portfolio. Must collaborate with Facial Aesthetics, Plastic Surgery, Coolsculpting, APC’s, Marketing, and other Allergan sales forces. Complies with required reports, requests, and compliance policies.
Effectively manages field assets and resources to include, but not limited to, expense management, computer, and other allocated equipment.
SALES RESULTS: Consistently achieves sales quota for skin care, consumables, and equipment. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans to include device placement and pull through product promotions (device, consumables and SkinMedica portfolio). Creates call plans across product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability with multiple initiatives.
Demonstrates effective selling skills (demonstrate DiamondGlow Treatments, educate customers on proper techniques for DiamondGlow Treatments, consultative sales approach to the customers' business, pre-call plans, Intro/credentialing, assessment of customer needs, handling objections, presentation delivery with visuals, closing, follow-up, etc.). Builds loyal relationships; high level customer interaction.
Calls on and effectively manages time with new and existing customers to educate on new and current products. Works with customers toward business development by assessing and product needs, placing account orders, merchandising office, and supporting events for pull-through.
Manages initiative execution across the portfolio balancing the device sale to drive skin care and consumable business. Demonstrates ability to assess territory metrics to develop and implement territory business plans; computer proficiency (excel, internet, PowerPoint); use of sales reporting tools; responds timely to corporate requests; balances work load demonstrating good organizational skills, and optimizes corporate resource and budget allocation. Provides product samples as necessary.
Educates customers on device and product features and benefits through individual and group presentations/trainings. Conveys consistent differentiating messaging across portfolio; technical fluency across Allergan and competitive product portfolio. Demonstrates an expertise in discussing support studies/material, proficient with knowledge of the aesthetic market. Portrays strong business acumen.
Demonstrates the ability to execute marketing plans across product portfolio. Understands sales execution role within the marketing plan. Ability to understand marketing team's role and provide appropriate feedback to plan implementation. Ability to articulate strategy to RM and team members. Ability to understand how individual tactics support the overall strategic direction. Understands and adheres to compliance and travel/expense policies.
Exemplifies integrity, flexibility, and adaptability. Ability to understand multiple perspectives of decisions beyond one territory. Is self-aware of interaction with customers, peers, etc. Demonstrates the ability to make sound decisions and uses good judgment. Is reliable and has a willingness to improve. Portrays a positive and productive attitude in working with counterparts toward collaboration supporting the portfolio of business.
Bachelor's degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Minimum of 3+ years of sales experience required with business to business to consumer (B2B2C) sales experience preferred.
Aesthetics sales background or related experience with a skin care company highly desirable
Valid driver’s license
Analytical skills. Strong business acumen. Proven selling skills
Analytical skills. Strong business acumen. Proven selling skills
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong contract/negotiating skills
Financial/budgetary experience
Ability to travel . Ability to lift 50 lbs.
Proficiency on excel, word, power point and other software skills

title: 2027 University Graduate - Technical Support Consultant
description:
Join Adobe’s Experience Manager (AEM) Customer Engineering team—the expert group at the front lines of helping enterprises craft, deliver and optimize digital experiences at scale. Our team supports AEM developers and business users across the globe, guiding them through performance tuning, problem solving, debugging complex issues and expanding what’s possible with AEM as a Cloud Service.
As an AEM Customer Engineering Intern, you’ll get hands on exposure to one of the most powerful enterprise Content Management Systems in the world. You’ll work closely with AEM experts to build internal tools that enhance customer support efficiency, improve workflows and streamline team operations. This is an incredible opportunity to learn how high scale systems are supported in production and to grow your technical and problem-solving skills in a collaborative, innovative environment.
The work you'll do is unique—you'll dive into Adobe Experience Manager’s modern cloud stack, which touches technologies such as:
Java, Sling, and OSGi frameworks
Adobe I/O Runtime and microservices
CI/CD automation through AEM Cloud Manager
Frontend frameworks like React and GraphQL
If you thrive in solving technical puzzles, enjoy working on tools that make other engineers more efficient, and want to contribute to real customer impact—this role is for you.
All 2026 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.
What You’ll Do
Learn AEM’s technology stack—from authoring to publishing, from the backend (Sling, OSGi, Oak) to frontend frameworks (HTL, React).
Design and develop internal tools and automations to help Customer Engineering streamline diagnostics and support workflows.
Analyze and improve existing processes by identifying efficiency opportunities and building practical solutions.
Solve and investigate AEM issues, learning debugging techniques used in enterprise environments.
Contribute to internal documentation and wikis to support continuous information flow.
Engage in team discussions and standups, learning agile workflows and customer support methodologies.
Partner with internal stakeholders across Product Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand cross functional operations.

Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related technical field or equivalent degree required with an expected graduation date of December 2026– June 2027
1-2 years of experience with HTML, JavaScript, CSS, REST APIs, JSON, XML
Languages such as Java or Python — with an understanding of object-oriented principles
Excellent communication and collaboration skills

title: Compliance Risk & Assurance
location: San Jose; San Francisco; Seattle; New York
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe’s Business Ethics & Integrity organization is continuing to evolve our data-driven, risk-based approach to compliance - one that proactively identifies emerging risks, continuously evaluates the effectiveness of our controls, and uses data and technology to generate meaningful insights and drive continuous improvement.
We’re looking for a Compliance Risk & Assurance professional to help continue maturing these capabilities across Adobe’s global Business Ethics & Integrity program. This role will connect compliance risk assessments, monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, and analytics to help us understand where our most significant risks are, whether our compliance processes and controls are effectively mitigating those risks, and where we should focus our efforts and resources.
You’ll work across Business Ethics & Integrity and partner closely with Legal, Internal Audit, and other teams to develop scalable, risk-based assurance and monitoring capabilities. You’ll also support compliance due diligence in M&A and explore opportunities to leverage data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies - including AI - to strengthen risk identification, improve efficiency, and generate actionable insights.
This is an opportunity to help shape how a global technology company identifies and manages compliance risks, evaluates program effectiveness, and drives continuous improvement.
What You'll Do
Develop and execute compliance risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and prioritize ethics and compliance risks across Adobe’s businesses, geographies, and operations.
Design and implement risk-based compliance monitoring and assurance activities to evaluate the effectiveness of compliance processes and controls, identify gaps, and drive remediation and continuous improvement.
Build and enhance continuous monitoring capabilities, leveraging compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, trends, anomalies, and potential control weaknesses across key compliance risk areas.
Develop meaningful risk indicators, dashboards, metrics, and reporting to provide leadership with actionable insights into compliance risks, program effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with Legal, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to evaluate findings, identify root causes, develop practical remediation plans, and strengthen compliance processes and controls.
Support M&A compliance risk assessments and due diligence, including identifying potential ethics and compliance risks and supporting post-close integration and remediation.
Leverage analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of compliance risk assessment, monitoring, and assurance activities.
Support broader Ethics & Compliance Office initiatives and priorities, including enhancements to compliance policies, processes, governance, and other program activities as needed.
What You'll Need to Succeed
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
8+ years of relevant experience in corporate ethics and compliance, compliance risk management, or compliance monitoring and assurance, ideally within a global company or similarly complex environment. Experience in internal audit or risk advisory may be relevant when accompanied by substantive corporate ethics and compliance experience.
Strong understanding of corporate ethics and compliance programs, including key compliance risk areas, regulatory expectations, risk assessment methodologies, compliance monitoring, and approaches to evaluating program effectiveness.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or executing compliance risk assessments, risk-based compliance monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, or compliance assurance activities.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, evaluate trends and anomalies, assess program effectiveness, and inform risk-based decisions.
Experience developing or leveraging metrics, dashboards, key risk indicators, and management reporting to support risk-based decision-making.
Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar technologies, is preferred. Experience applying automation or AI-enabled capabilities to compliance monitoring and assurance is a plus.
Knowledge of core corporate compliance risk areas, including anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, and third-party risk.
Experience with M&A compliance due diligence, integration, or risk assessment is preferred.
Strong critical thinking, professional skepticism, and sound judgment, with the ability to connect data, compliance observations, and business context to broader compliance risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear, practical recommendations for senior leaders.
Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, Security, technical teams, and business functions.
Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and help build new capabilities in an evolving environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it.
The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion.
You will work in a cross-functional Customer Pod: a small, autonomous team with end-to-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.
What You'll Do
Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals.
Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third-party systems.
Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance.
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust.
Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work.
Feed field patterns back to product and engineering to shape the Workfront roadmap.
Mentor engineers in the pod and set practices for how the team documents decisions and learnings.
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go-live and expansion.
What Success Looks Like
We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates show:
Customer empathy. You meet customers on their terms and understand their constraints and definition of success.
Ownership at senior level. You find problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution without waiting for permission.
Clear communication. You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings.
Business acumen. You understand the use case before choosing the technology.
Software craft. You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality.
Data and integration judgment. You weigh trade-offs in data models, API design, and system integration.
Growth mindset and AI fluency. You use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities.
Typical background: 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering. What matters is what that experience produced, not the title or the number of years.
Your Domain
Work management platforms: Workfront or comparable tools (project, portfolio, resource, planning, proofing, and approval workflows).
Integration and automation: REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and low-code or workflow orchestration tools such as Workfront Fusion.
Enterprise architecture: Multi-system integration, SSO and identity, data flows, and API design across complex landscapes.
Application development: Strong skills in a modern language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
Cloud and data: AWS or Azure, plus reporting and analytics pipelines.
Security and compliance: Enterprise permissions, data privacy, and regulated-industry constraints.
Nice to Have
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or Creative Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Workfront Planning, or Adobe GenStudio.
Background in SaaS work management, PPM, or marketing operations platforms.
Experience building agentic or LLM-powered workflows in enterprise settings.
Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government.
Track record of driving architecture decisions at team or organization level.
How You'll Work: Pod-Based Execution
You operate within a small, cross-functional Customer Pod embedded with specific strategic accounts. Each pod has a customer representative for feedback and validation, a product manager for prioritization, engineers and builders for implementation and experimentation, and an account team with enterprise architects for alignment and strategy.
The Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical execution backbone of the pod: customer-facing, hands-on, and focused on rapid end-to-end delivery. We run small, time-boxed experiments, keep tight customer feedback loops, prototype before fully building, document decisions, and use staged rollouts to reduce risk.
Why This Team
Solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact. Your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks.
Work in autonomous pods embedded with Adobe's most strategic accounts.
Combine architecture, engineering, and customer engagement in one role, so no two weeks look the same.
Help shape a new engineering engagement model built on rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution.
Join the Lehi engineering community alongside experienced Workfront platform engineers.

title: Business Process Improvement Manager
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.
The Difference You Will Make:
The Business Process Manager will be a senior individual contributor within the Service Optimization team, part of the Community Service Organization. This role advances the team's process engineering discipline by designing systems where problems do not occur, rather than only improving processes that already exist. The Business Process Manager delivers through deep individual expertise: applying systems thinking, engineering processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, and building AI prototypes to test and validate new process designs before full implementation. This is a role for a senior level practitioner who operates at the intersection of process engineering, systems design, and applied AI.
A Typical Day:
Develop business strategies within Service Optimization and Community Support across people, process, and technology.
Lead the operationalization of strategies across Community Support and other cross functional teams such as Policy, Finance, and Product.
Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
Apply and coach others to apply a systems thinking lens to every problem: map full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
Design processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, engineering every future state around three standards: does it reduce agent and customer burden, is it measurable from day one, and can it be automated or self-correcting over time.
Build AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
Use process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
Develop and continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
Build and scale process engineering competency, systems thinking, and AI-ready design, contributing to capability building across the team.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.
Communicate progress and findings to senior leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes
Your Expertise:
Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of post-graduate experience in operations, process management, or process improvement, with at least 7 years in a customer support operations environment (preferred).
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.
Demonstrated ability to build AI prototypes and proof-of-concept workflow automations: practical experience using AI tools, no-code or low-code platforms, or scripting to test and validate process designs before full implementation.
Demonstrated mastery to design processes for AI-readiness and automation, engineering systems that evolve with AI capabilities rather than simply optimizing existing workflows.
Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
Advanced statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.
Experience using process simulation tools to model process behavior, test design assumptions, and predict outcomes under varying conditions prior to implementation.
Demonstrated experience driving organizational change, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, and adoption measurement.
Proven ability to interact and communicate with people at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, in an open and transparent manner.
Proven ability to work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to influence, structure arguments clearly, and drive alignment to measurable outcomes without formal authority.
Demonstrated focus on end-to-end customer journey and customer-centric outcomes.
Prior experience developing business processes in customer support operating models that balance multiple stakeholder interests.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.
Proactive and autonomous: able to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to travel up to 20% of time.

description:
Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.
As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. - Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems

- Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
- Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
- Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
- Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
- Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
- Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
- Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels
Preferred qualifications: - Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- 3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

title: Launch Program Manager, Global Engineering Services (GES) Launch
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, the Global Engineering Services Launch Team needs talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. The key to this mission is strategic, large scale project management initiatives that will allow us to scale our organization for the future in an extraordinary manner. The Launch team is seeking a qualified candidate to solve the complex challenges of progressive innovation to drive efficiencies at operational benchmark rates. We are looking for a customer-obsessed Program Manager with proven program management experience and a strong track record of delivering results to own and execute highly strategic launches, in addition to driving multiple complex projects across one or more programs. If you are looking for an environment where you can drive business innovation amidst various levels of ambiguity, this is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing team within Amazon!
As a Launch Program Manager, you will work with and influence numerous cross-functional stakeholders both inside and outside of Global Engineering Services (GES) with a direct impact to our internal customers in operations. This role calls for an individual who is proficient in continuous improvement and is experienced in strategically developing processes and mechanisms to achieve business goals.
This role requires up to 75% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.
Key job responsibilities
• Gain trust and consistently deliver results
• Work backwards from the customer to scope and define program requirements and critical milestones
• Navigate ambiguous situations without heavily relying on direct support from their leader
• Demonstrate a high level of ownership to drive multiple time sensitive actions items simultaneously through multiple business groups
• Manage multiple projects with competing deadlines whilst maintaining a customer focus
• Collaborate and influence team members, work with development teams and other business groups, and present projects to senior leadership on a regular basis
• Partner to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year
• Optimize cross-team processes that improve team efficacy and delivery
• Take ownership and accountability for programs, while maintaining the ability to ask for help, and escalate issues and problems as necessary to keep programs on track
• Problem solve with a high degree of ambiguity and operating in a rapidly evolving and changing landscape
• Dive into the details and leverage high judgment and gut instinct
• Communicate effectively to all stakeholders related to a launch or program/project
• This role requires extensive travel, up to 75%.
A day in the life
• Managing the Road to Launch process, which ultimately allows for a building hand-off that passes operational readiness testing and sets the operations team up for success
• Managing day-to-day relationships with multiple site types under the GES Launch Team scope

description:
You're a Principal Product Manager with deep experience in freight, supply chain, or logistics product strategy within complex, rapidly scaling organizations. You've owned end-to-end product vision for a freight or transportation product at scale, and you have a track record of turning multi-leg, multi-modal networks into a single differentiated product that shippers choose. You excel where the problem spans air and ground operations, cross-border complexity, commercial strategy, and customer experience — and you bring the strategic judgment to define the right long-term bets while delivering near-term value.
You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into lane economics, transit-time and connection reliability, first- and last-mile ground performance, international compliance and customs flow, and the cost and margin structure of an end-to-end freight product. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting the product direction for how Amazon Air Cargo moves freight from gateway to gateway, extends it into a true door-to-door experience, and connects international lanes into the domestic network across two regions.
High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the product promise across air and ground legs, making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer experience, deciding when to build versus influence a platform or operations team's roadmap, and influencing across operations, network, commercial, finance, compliance, and engineering teams — across the US and EU — without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building a freight or transportation product that became a durable competitive advantage.
Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy Across the Freight Express Journey — Own the end-to-end product strategy for Freight Express across three connected layers:
Gateway-to-gateway — the existing Amazon Air Cargo airport-to-airport experience, from booking through air movement to arrival.
End-to-end with ground — extend the product into a door-to-door experience by integrating first-mile and last-mile ground into a single, reliable freight offering.
International — enable international lanes to feed into the domestic Freight Express network, connecting cross-border origins into the end-to-end product. Define the product customer-back across all three, with a single coherent promise rather than a stack of disconnected legs.
Multi-Region Ownership (US & EU) — Own the Freight Express product experience across both the US and EU. Account for the regulatory, operational, and commercial differences between regions while holding a consistent product bar, and decide where the product converges across regions versus where it must adapt.
End-to-End Product Lifecycle & Quality Ownership — Own the full product cycle and the quality of the product at every stage:
Product definition & strategy — set the vision and translate it into clear, prioritized product requirements.
Capability enhancement — drive the roadmap of capabilities that close gaps across the air and ground legs and the international feed.
Performance measurement — instrument the product and define success metrics up front; measure actual performance against the product promise and the business case.
Quality improvement — identify quality gaps from the data (connection misses, ground exceptions, customs delays, failure modes) and drive the highest-impact improvements back into the product and network. Continuously evolve the product based on customer feedback, operational quality and cost, and P&L outcomes.
Cross-Team & Network Leadership — Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, driving alignment across air gateway operations, ground first/last-mile carriers, international and customs operations, commercial, and engineering. Translate hard operational constraints (gateway cutoffs, ground pickup/delivery timing, cross-border clearance) into a single recommended path and a product customers can rely on. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the air-to-ground and international-to-domestic seams; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.
A day in the life
Set the strategic direction for the Freight Express product across teams — aligning air, ground, international, commercial, and engineering around one gateway-to-gateway-to-door product definition.
Deep dive into data (lane economics, connection and on-time performance, ground first/last-mile reliability, customs and cross-border delays, customer feedback) to shape the roadmap and decide where to invest for maximum reliability and margin impact.
Run the product cycle end to end — move initiatives from strategy to requirements to capability launch, then measure outcomes, surface quality gaps, and feed them back into the next iteration.
Partner with engineering and operations leaders across the US and EU to shape network and product design, ensuring the product scales and holds its service promise in both regions.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting network and product progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and in the network — air gateways and ground legs — to pressure-test whether the product performs for shippers in the real world.
What this takes
Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle across air and ground, domestic and international, US and EU — and turning a complex multi-modal, multi-region network into a single reliable Freight Express product that shippers choose.

description:
Device Technologies (DT) provides the infrastructure that lets Amazon's operations teams provision, deploy, and manage the edge devices, robotics, and material-handling equipment they run on. We build the connectivity, observability, and scale underneath them, so builder teams can bring their hardware online and keep it running across Amazon's worldwide operations and the deliveries customers depend on. Our products are in use across fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and grocery sites. Our job is to make Amazon's frontline technology self-service and dependable. Operators should set up, recover, and manage their own devices without waiting on us, and a device that fails should be back at work in minutes. You'll set the strategy and roadmap for your area, decide which problems matter most, and work backward from the people who run our sites every day: process-path owners, application teams, and site operators. The work is technical and the stakes are operational — when there's a device issue on-site, packages stop moving.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area, working backward from the needs of Amazon's operations customers and the economics of running a global fulfillment network.

- Move DT's core outcomes measurably forward: empowering builder teams to move fast on their own (self-service), returning devices to productive work quickly when they fail (availability), and lowering the cost to serve each site.
- Decide where AI, including agentic and generative capabilities, genuinely improves the product or the speed at which your team builds, and where it adds risk or complexity that isn't worth it.
- Define the metrics that tell you whether the product is working, instrument them, and use site-level data and operator feedback to decide what to build next.
A day in the life
No two days are the same, but most begin with data from the floor. You might start with overnight numbers from a site rollout: adoption, device health, ticket volume, and the questions they raise about what to prioritize next. By mid-morning you're in a design review, pushing engineering on whether a recovery flow holds up under the conditions of a live building. The afternoon is for writing: a PR/FAQ for a capability you want funded, or a document that works through a trade-off you need leadership to weigh in on. You end the day with your partners in operations and the application teams who build on DT, making sure what you're about to ship will land cleanly in the sites that depend on it.

title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, QC Pre-Construction, North America Quick Commerce
description:
The Quick Commerce (QC) Pre-Construction team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III (TIPM III) to own the pre-construction strategy, technical design standards, site feasibility evaluation, and international design benchmarking for QC’s rapidly scaling North America network.
QC deploys multiple physical infrastructure formats, including Stand Alone and Co-Located sites, where pre-construction requirements vary by site type, existing building conditions, infrastructure capacity, permitting jurisdiction, and deployment scenario.
This role operates at the intersection of technical design and site readiness, defining how prospective QC sites are evaluated for infrastructure feasibility, how design packages produced by Architects of Record (AORs) and Engineers of Record (EORs) are reviewed for constructability and specification compliance, and how international quick commerce design approaches are benchmarked and adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.
The TIPM III will develop and maintain site evaluation criteria, technical design review standards, AOR/EOR performance frameworks, cost estimating methodologies, permitting strategies, and change-management mechanisms that govern QC pre-construction delivery. You will use technical domain knowledge to assess site feasibility, evaluate AOR/EOR design deliverables, identify design and permitting risks, challenge cost and schedule assumptions, benchmark technical solutions against international quick commerce operators, and provide feedback to Design Engineering, Real Estate, and Construction teams for specification and process improvement.
This role goes beyond reviewing a completed design package. You will define and continuously improve the pre-construction process itself into scalable standards that improve speed, design quality, cost predictability, and constructability across the QC portfolio.
Key job responsibilities
• Own and continuously improve QC pre-construction technical design and site evaluation standards across formats.
• Develop site feasibility criteria, technical design review checklists, cost estimating frameworks, and due diligence standards.
• Define new pre-construction processes where established evaluation methods, design review workflows, or permitting strategies do not yet exist.
• Evaluate prospective sites for infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, constructability, permitting complexity, cost, and operational requirements to inform site selection decisions.
• Lead technical review of AOR and EOR design deliverables, evaluating design packages for constructability, specification compliance, infrastructure integration risks, code compliance, and alignment with QC deployment standards before construction handoff.
• Benchmark QC technical design standards against international quick commerce operators, identifying design innovations, infrastructure approaches, and deployment methodologies that can be adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.
• Partner with Design Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, and external AOR/EOR partners to resolve complex pre-construction issues and align site evaluation criteria.
• Root-cause recurring pre-construction issues and translate findings into upstream improvements to site selection criteria, design specifications, AOR/EOR scopes, cost models, and permitting processes.
• Establish change-management mechanisms ensuring design learnings, cost data, jurisdictional findings, and international benchmarking insights are consistently incorporated into future site evaluations and design standards.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex pre-construction issues, determining whether gaps stem from site conditions, AOR/EOR design quality, cost assumptions, permitting, or evaluation methodology.
A day in the life
You start by reviewing a batch of prospective sites, assessing infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, permitting jurisdiction complexity, and technical constraints to inform site selection and determine fit for QC deployment. Mid-morning, you lead a design review session on an AOR’s 90% construction document set, flagging a refrigeration layout concern and a fire protection code question that need resolution before permit submission. After lunch, compare QC’s cold-chain infrastructure approach against a leading international quick commerce operator’s design, identifying an equipment standardization opportunity worth exploring. You then join a call with a municipality and EDP partners to resolve an open plan review comment that is holding up a permit timeline. Before end of day, you document lessons from a recently permitted site and update the EOR scope of work template so the next design cycle captures requirements that were missed in this round. Your work turns site evaluation, design review, and international benchmarking learnings into repeatable improvements for future QC deployments.
About the team
The QC Pre-Construction team evaluates and prepares multiple site formats across varying building conditions, jurisdictions, and infrastructure configurations supporting Amazon’s Quick Commerce across North America. TIPMs work alongside Pre-Construction Managers, Construction, Design Engineering, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, EDP, and external AOR/EOR partners to develop scalable pre-construction solutions. While Pre-Construction Managers lead day-to-day site evaluation and project setup activities, TIPMs define and improve the technical standards that guide how sites are assessed and how design partners deliver.
Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area and a minimum 10 years relevant industry experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

title: Hardware Systems Engineering Manager
description:
Apple is where you do the best work of your life. Behind every Apple product is a remarkable collaboration of engineering disciplines, where innovation, precision, and attention to detail shape experiences enjoyed by millions of people worldwide.
Imagine shaping how the next generation of Apple products is designed, understood, and continuously improved. From silicon to complete systems, the ability to observe, measure, and understand hardware behavior is fundamental to building exceptional products.
Our team works at the intersection of product architecture, electrical engineering, and intelligent metrology, partnering with design teams to develop innovative electrical architectures, embedded observability, and scalable measurement solutions. We influence product designs early, enabling deeper system insights through hardware, firmware, and software integration. Where additional capabilities are needed, we architect specialized instrumentation and measurement platforms that extend our understanding of product behavior from early development through production.
We are looking for an engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a passion for developing exceptional teams. You will lead electrical engineers across a diverse portfolio of Apple products, advancing common architectures, AI-enabled engineering methodologies, and scalable solutions that influence how products are designed and delivered.
This is a leadership role at the forefront of hardware systems engineering, where you will drive the development of innovative electrical architectures, embedded observability capabilities, and precision metrology systems across Apple's product portfolio.
You will manage and develop a talented team of electrical engineers responsible for advancing system-level design methodologies, developing custom electrical instrumentation, and delivering scalable engineering solutions that support product development, characterization, calibration, and manufacturing.
Beyond delivering engineering solutions, you will help shape the team's technical direction, identifying opportunities to influence product architecture, establish common platforms, and leverage AI-driven technologies to accelerate engineering development and improve decision-making.
The role requires close collaboration with silicon, hardware, firmware, software, and operations teams, along with the ability to communicate complex engineering strategies and influence technical decisions across organizational boundaries.
Occasional domestic and international travel may be required based on business needs.
Minimum qualifications: BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
3+ years of engineering management experience with strong hands-on hardware systems expertise, or 7+ years of technical leadership experience with demonstrated readiness for people management.
Extensive experience in hardware systems development, including architecture, schematic design, PCB layout, bring-up, characterization, and deployment.
Strong electrical engineering fundamentals spanning analog, power electronics, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital design.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering initiatives and collaborate across multiple technical disciplines.

title: Head of Content Strategy, Sales Coach
description:
Imagine shaping how over 400,000 salespeople across 103 countries learn, connect, and share the Apple experience with customers every single day. Worldwide Channel Sales Programs (CSP) drives in-store sales across more than 50,000 points of sale worldwide. Together with our channel partners, we build an unmatched retail experience through store design, merchandising, demo technology, staffing, and the daily content that empowers every seller on the floor.
We are looking for a Head of Content Strategy for Sales Coach, Apple's mobile engagement and learning platform for partner salespeople. Part content strategist, part creative leader, and part product owner, this role lives at the intersection of learning, culture, and mobile platform engagement. Your primary mission is driving active engagement: inspiring new sellers to open Sales Coach for the first time, and creating an experience so compelling that active users keep coming back. If you know how to build a modern content engine that feels like a feed people choose to watch rather than training they are assigned to complete, we want to talk to you.
As the Head of Content Strategy for Sales Coach, you will own the content vision, roadmap, and production engine end to end for a global audience spanning 50+ languages. You will lead content across two core tracks: product knowledge and selling skills that make sellers sharper on the sales floor, and culture and employer brand storytelling that makes every seller (whether Apple-badged or partner staff) feel proud to be part of the ecosystem.
In this role, you will:
Own the Global Content Strategy & Roadmap: Define what great content looks like for a 400,000-person, 103-country audience and translate that vision into an actionable roadmap. Partner closely with Product Management to shape "Ask" (Sales Coach's Q&A experience), owning the content strategy and presentation that answers sellers' daily questions.
Build the Team & the Production Engine: Assemble, lead, and develop a high-performing team of content creatives and learning design specialists. Build and evolve AI-accelerated production and localization workflows that allow the team to produce high-impact video and digital content at scale across 50+ languages.
Set the Creative Bar: Act as a hands-on creative leader who reviews scripts, visual concepts, and video cuts. Provide actionable direction that elevates the craft before work ships, ensuring every piece of content is thumb-stopping, platform-native, and unmistakably Apple.
Run a Continuous Test-and-Learn Loop: Use platform engagement data to run rapid experiments, double down on high-performing formats, adapt what needs refinement, and decisively retire underperforming or outdated assets so the catalog remains sharp and relevant.
